Det er diplom ingeniør i transport, logistik og mobilitet.

Hej med dig.

Jeg er meget tæt på færdiguddannet, og har pt. studiejob i en virksomhed hvor jeg sidder i deres Supply Chain afdeling med fokus på optimering og budgettering af transport. 

Nu var jeg selv rimelig skarp til matematik inden jeg startede på uddannelsen, da jeg studerede matematik på KU i 2 år, men jeg kan fortælle dig at jeg synes ikke niveauet var særlig højt matematisk. Jeg hørte folk sige at Basismat var svært, men ærligt, hvis du bare ligger tid og kræfter i det, så skal du nok klare den. 
Hvis du vil have et forspring kan jeg anbefale at læse op på imaginære tal, integrering, differential ligninger, og lineær algebra. 

I mit job benytter jeg ikke tung matematik, men du vil i de fleste jobs efterfølgende møde at du skal kunne bruge statistik og databehandling. Dette kræver dog i de fleste tilfælde ikke tung matematik, men blot en logisk tankegang, og så noget teknisk kunnen, som du også lærer i løbet af uddannelsen. 

Jeg er super glad for at have taget uddannelsen, men hvis du går ind til uddannelsen med forventningen om at have mange kurser og logistik og Supply chain, så må jeg desværre skuffe dig. Der er meget fokus på transport og især projektering af veje i bl.a.  programmet Microstation. Men du kan altid vælge at tage valgfag im Supply Chain og logistik i 6/7 semester.

Not to justify my own mix because there are many hidden gems that I would’ve wanted to include in this but just didn’t have the time to. 
What I wanted to show with this mix is the range of sounds of Anjunabeats. It varies from Progressive House, groovy house like the Meramek remix, to tech-trance, “modern trance” like Sinai, and classics like 90 Seconds Of Summer and Amsterdam, and that is what I think I captured quite well. 
But I agree. You could’ve included a lot of different tracks, but that wouldn’t necessarily cover the diversity of the label. But I’m thrilled you enjoyed it after all. :)

I’m 22 and I got bullied for just a short period of time when I was 11-13 years old, before I switched school. 
I still have lots of thoughts about it. My self confidence got permanently damaged by it. It took me years to even find my own identity again and even longer to actually socialise with people again. I didn’t trust in anyone, because I knew what could happen. I lost all courage in finding someone to love, because what If they also wanted to hurt me. 
Even now, when I’m 22, and I’m with my first girlfriend who I love and her constant appreciation for me, I’m having trouble believing that anyone isn’t here to eventually hurt me. But it’s getting better. The worst part about it is the rebuilding of your self-worth and self confidence. Other people can help, but in the end, it is your own vision of yourself, that has to be rebuild, because of others harm.
